question: Among them, can you show me the distribution and timeline of health inspections?
output_text:
The health inspection records for Salt Lake County show a clear timeline and score distribution: ### Timeline of Inspections The number of inspections recorded per year shows the frequency of health department activity over time, spanning from 2009 through recent years. ### Distribution of Inspection Scores The histogram below illustrates the distribution of inspection scores. A lower score typically indicates a cleaner inspection (fewer or less severe violations), while higher scores indicate more significant issues were found. *(Note: The data includes some entries with future dates, which may be due to data entry errors in the source records.)*

trace_text:
Action: get_schema({})

Observation: Project food_health_viz {
  database_type: 'DuckDB'
}

Table establishment_keys {
  slchd_establishment_key varchar [pk, note: 'NAME|ADDRESS|CITY']
  name varchar [not null]
  address varchar [not null]
  city varchar [not null]
  city_state_zip varchar
  establishment_type varchar
  source varchar [note: 'friend_slc | own_scrape']
  slchd_lat double
  slchd_lon double
  geocode_status varchar [note: 'Match | Match_Nominatim | No_Match | Tie']

  Note: 'SLCHD establishment list, one row per portal listing.'
}

Table category {
  category_id integer [pk]
  category varchar
}

Table establishments {
  gmap_id varchar [pk]
  name varchar
  address varchar
  description varchar
  geom geometry [note: 'ST_Point(longitude, latitude), spatial extension']
  avg_rating double
  num_of_reviews integer
  price varchar
  slchd_establishment_key varchar [ref: > establishment_keys.slchd_establishment_key, note: 'nullable; set when ER matched']

  Note: 'One row per Google Local place — all restaurants, not just SLCHD-matched.'
}

Table establishment_attributes {
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id, not null]
  attribute varchar [not null]

  indexes { (gmap_id, attribute) [pk] }

  Note: 'Flattened meta.MISC leaf values. Outer category label (e.g. "Service options") dropped.'
}

Table establishment_categories {
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id, not null]
  category_id integer [ref: > category.category_id, not null]

  indexes { (gmap_id, category_id) [pk] }
}

Table gmap_hours {
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id, not null]
  day integer [not null, note: '0=Sun … 6=Sat']
  open_min bigint
  open_max bigint

  indexes { (gmap_id, day) [pk] }

  Note: 'Covers every meta place with parsable hours, not just the SLCHD-matched subset.'
}

Table review {
  user_id varchar
  name varchar
  time bigint
  rating double
  text varchar
  resp varchar
  gmap_id varchar [ref: > establishments.gmap_id]
}

Table inspection_types {
  inspection_type_id integer [pk, note: 'parsed leading number, e.g. "01 - Routine" -> 1']
  description varchar [note: 'e.g. "Routine"']
}

Table inspections {
  inspection_id bigint [pk, increment]
  slchd_establishment_key varchar [ref: > establishment_keys.slchd_establishment_key, not null]
  inspection_date date [not null]
  inspection_type_id integer [ref: > inspection_types.inspection_type_id, note: 'nullable — 27 rows have no type']
  inspection_score integer

  Note: 'One row per inspection visit. count_critical/noncritical_violations dropped (derivable from violations).'
}

Table violation_codes {
  violation_code_id integer [pk, increment]
  code_text varchar [not null, note: 'base code, asterisks stripped, e.g. "4.5.18"']
  asterisk_count integer [not null, note: '0/1/2 trailing * in source, meaning unconfirmed']
  critical boolean [not null]
}

Table violations {
  violation_id bigint [pk, increment]
  inspection_id bigint [ref: > inspections.inspection_id, not null]
  violation_code_id integer [ref: > violation_codes.violation_code_id, not null]
  violation_description varchar [note: 'per-occurrence free text']
  violation_occurrences integer
  violation_cos boolean [note: 'corrected on site']
  violation_phr varchar [note: 'public health rationale']

  Note: 'One row per violation actually cited. Zero-violation inspections get zero rows (no placeholder row).'
}


Action: run_sql({'query': 'SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT slchd_establishment_key) AS establishments_with_inspections FROM inspections'})

Observation: {"row_count": 1, "truncated": false, "rows": [{"establishments_with_inspections": 1315}]}

Action: run_sql({'query': 'SELECT MIN(inspection_date) as start_date, MAX(inspection_date) as end_date FROM inspections'})

Observation: {"row_count": 1, "truncated": false, "rows": [{"start_date": "2009-01-09 00:00:00", "end_date": "2026-07-17 00:00:00"}]}

Action: plot_chart({'chart_type': 'line', 'query': "SELECT strftime('%Y', inspection_date) AS inspection_year, COUNT(*) AS inspection_count FROM inspections GROUP BY inspection_year ORDER BY inspection_year ASC", 'title': 'Number of Health Inspections per Year', 'x': 'inspection_year', 'y': 'inspection_count'})

Observation: Chart created: 'Number of Health Inspections per Year' (line, 18 rows). It will be shown to the user below your answer.

Action: plot_chart({'chart_type': 'histogram', 'query': 'SELECT inspection_score FROM inspections WHERE inspection_score IS NOT NULL', 'title': 'Distribution of Inspection Scores', 'x': 'inspection_score'})

Observation: Chart created: 'Distribution of Inspection Scores' (histogram, 7798 rows). It will be shown to the user below your answer.
